column1: # Theories of the gate's lists that the proved-only backend is known not to
# finish within the limits yet. scripts/backend_gate.py runs them anyway, on
# proved-only with the short --pending-timeout, and reports each as XFAIL.
# An entry excuses a proved-only run that does not finish or is too slow. It
# never excuses a verdict that differs from Maude's. An entry whose theory
# finishes within the limits fails the gate as XPASS until the line is
# removed, so this file cannot outlive the defect it records.
